rules.name: Minimum 4-Hour Call Guarantee
rules.description: Any crew member called in must be paid a minimum of 4 hours.

rules.name: Meal Penalty After 5 Hours
rules.description: Meal break required every 5 hours or penalty hourly rate applies.

rules.name: 8-Hour Turnaround Rest Requirement
rules.description: Minimum 8 hours rest between end of load-out and next call.
